title: search placement home vs results
name: Search placement home vs results
rule: Search placement — landing/home: top-right (where people expect it). Results page: search box closer to the results so query and hits read as related. Dual-cite USWDS persist-query / homepage-is-a-box.
pass_when: Home search is top-right; results-page search sits close to the hits.
fail_when: Home search is not where people expect (top-right); results-page search is far from the hits.
overview: Home search sits top-right; results-page search sits close to the hits.
apply_when: Placing search on landing/home versus results pages.
not_when: Non-search navigation or filters that are not the search box.
agent_hint: Put home search top-right; keep results-page search near the hits.
description: On landing/home, place search top-right where people expect it. On results pages, place the search box closer to the results so query and hits read as related. Dual-cite USWDS persist-query / homepage-is-a-box. Pass when home search is top-right and results-page search sits close to the hits; fail when home search is not where people expect or results-page search is far from the hits.
do_not_claim: Search input attributes (autocomplete/spellcheck) as this placement row; USWDS persist-query as a merge.
